parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Minimum value: **0**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if there is no next query.
- If there is a next query, set the value to the **NextToken** value that is returned from the previous API call.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC instance.
